stops.name: Blausee
stops.quote: Discover one of the most beautiful mountain lakes in Switzerland in the Kandertal Region of the Bernese Oberland.
stops.english: Discover one of the most beautiful mountain lakes in Switzerland in the Kandertal Region of the Bernese Oberland.

stops.name: organic trout farm
stops.quote: The entrance fee to the Blausee includes several offers: The picnic areas and barbecue areas, the natural playground for children and a visit to the organic trout farm with the natural ponds.
stops.english: The entrance fee to the Blausee includes several offers: The picnic areas and barbecue areas, the natural playground for children and a visit to the organic trout farm with the natural ponds.

stops.name: stone sculpture
stops.quote: Tree trunks, rocks and a mysterious stone sculpture at the bottom of the lake seem to be lying just below the surface of the water.
stops.english: Tree trunks, rocks and a mysterious stone sculpture at the bottom of the lake seem to be lying just below the surface of the water.

stops.name: lakeside path
stops.quote: The lakeside path with a wooden bridge and platform out onto the lake is absolutely picturesque.
stops.english: The lakeside path with a wooden bridge and platform out onto the lake is absolutely picturesque.

stops.name: Lake Oeschinen
stops.quote: In the Kandertal Region lies a second top excursion destination: the Lake Oeschinen above Kandersteg.
stops.english: In the Kandertal Region lies a second top excursion destination: the Lake Oeschinen above Kandersteg.

stops.name: Kandersteg
stops.quote: Buses run from Frutigen and Kandersteg to the Blausee stop.
stops.english: Buses run from Frutigen and Kandersteg to the Blausee stop.

stops.name: Allmenalp
stops.quote: Opposite on the Allmenalp you can climb through one of the most spectacular via ferratas in Switzerland.
stops.english: Opposite on the Allmenalp you can climb through one of the most spectacular via ferratas in Switzerland.

stops.name: Choleren Gorge
stops.quote: Learn more about: Adelboden Choleren Gorge
